name: karaoke
description: Karaokê pessoal com IA (Demucs + WhisperX), uso local

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @karaoke/api" "npm run dev -w @karaoke/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @karaoke/web && npm run build -w @karaoke/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @karaoke/api && npm run test -w @karaoke/web
